summary.text: Father of Imbrius (`imbrius-trojan`), rich in horses, who dwelt at Pedaeum before the war — distinct from Mentor the Ithacan companion of Odysseus and from Mentor the suitor of Penelope.

story.text: Before the sons of the Achaeans came, Imbrius son of Mentor, rich in horses, dwelt in Pedaeum and had to wife Medesicaste daughter of Priam; but when the curved ships came he returned to Troy and fought among the Trojans until Teucer son of Telamon was first to slay him.
